sql.closerDashboard.getIronmanFdcCounts:
-- Custom fields needed for closerDashboard.getIronmanFdcCounts query -- -- 'First Cash Payment Paid' object_type_id = 4, custom_field_id = 112, process_step_id = 57 -- 'Final Design Signed' object_type_id = 4, custom_field_id = 104, process_step_id = 9 -- 'Financial Agreement Signed' object_type_id = 4, custom_field_id = 108, process_step_id = 4 -- 'Source' object_type_id = 1, custom_field_id = 5 -- 'Financier' object_type_id = 4, custom_field_id = 109, process_step_id = 4 -- 'Cancelled' object_type_id = 1, custom_field_id = 52 -- 'On Hold' object_type_id = 1, custom_field_id = 200
WITH "quarters" AS ( select (extract('year' from now()) || '-01-01')::date as "q1_start", (extract('year' from now()) || '-03-31')::date as "q1_end", (extract('year' from now()) || '-04-01')::date as "q2_start", (extract('year' from now()) || '-06-30')::date as "q2_end", (extract('year' from now()) || '-07-01')::date as "q3_start", (extract('year' from now()) || '-09-30')::date as "q3_end", (extract('year' from now()) || '-10-01')::date as "q4_start", (extract('year' from now()) || '-12-31')::date as "q4_end" ) SELECT (select coalesce(sum(q1points), 0) from (select count(1) * case when greatest(first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between ('2020-01-01') and ('2020-01-31') and source in ('Referral', 'Setter Gen', 'Events - Closer Gen') then 1.5 when greatest(first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between ('2020-03-01') and ('2020-03-31') and source = 'Setter Gen' then 3 when greatest(first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between ('2020-03-01') and ('2020-03-31') and source in ('Referral', 'Events - Closer Gen') then 2 else 1 end as q1points from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.user_project up on up.project_id = p.id inner join flow.user_position upos on upos.id = up.user_position_id and upos.position_id = 1 inner join flow.user u on u.id = upos.user_id left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 112, p.id, 57, false) as first_cash_payment_paid_date) first_cash_payment_paid_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 104, p.id, 9, false) as final_design_signed_date) final_design_signed_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 108, p.id, 4, false) as agreement_signed_date) agreement_signed_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 5, p.id, 0, false) as source) source on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 109, p.id, 4, false) as financier) financier on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 52, p.id, 0, false) as cancelled_date) cancelled_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 200, p.id, 0, false) as on_hold) on_hold on true where final_design_signed_date is not null and agreement_signed_date is not null and case when financier = 'Cash' then first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and greatest(first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q1_start from quarters) and (select q1_end from quarters) else greatest(final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q1_start from quarters) and (select q1_end from quarters) end and ((cancelled_date is null) or (cancelled_date is not null and cancelled_date::date > (select q1_end from quarters))) and (on_hold is null or on_hold::boolean is false) and u.id = :currentUserId group by first_cash_payment_paid_date, final_design_signed_date, agreement_signed_date, source) t ) as "q1", (select count(1) from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.user_project up on up.project_id = p.id inner join flow.user_position upos on upos.id = up.user_position_id and upos.position_id = 1 inner join flow.user u on u.id = upos.user_id left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 112, p.id, 57, false) as first_cash_payment_paid_date) first_cash_payment_paid_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 104, p.id, 9, false) as final_design_signed_date) final_design_signed_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 108, p.id, 4, false) as agreement_signed_date) agreement_signed_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 109, p.id, 4, false) as financier) financier on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 52, p.id, 0, false) as cancelled_date) cancelled_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 200, p.id, 0, false) as on_hold) on_hold on true where final_design_signed_date is not null and agreement_signed_date is not null and case when financier = 'Cash' then first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and greatest(first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q2_start from quarters) and (select q2_end from quarters) else greatest(final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q2_start from quarters) and (select q2_end from quarters) end and ((cancelled_date is null) or (cancelled_date is not null and cancelled_date::date > (select q2_end from quarters))) and (on_hold is null or on_hold::boolean is false) and u.id = :currentUserId ) as "q2", (select count(1) from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.user_project up on up.project_id = p.id inner join flow.user_position upos on upos.id = up.user_position_id and upos.position_id = 1 inner join flow.user u on u.id = upos.user_id left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 112, p.id, 57, false) as first_cash_payment_paid_date) first_cash_payment_paid_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 104, p.id, 9, false) as final_design_signed_date) final_design_signed_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 108, p.id, 4, false) as agreement_signed_date) agreement_signed_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 109, p.id, 4, false) as financier) financier on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 52, p.id, 0, false) as cancelled_date) cancelled_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 200, p.id, 0, false) as on_hold) on_hold on true where final_design_signed_date is not null and agreement_signed_date is not null and case when financier = 'Cash' then first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and greatest(first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q3_start from quarters) and (select q3_end from quarters) else greatest(final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q3_start from quarters) and (select q3_end from quarters) end and ((cancelled_date is null) or (cancelled_date is not null and cancelled_date::date > (select q3_end from quarters))) and (on_hold is null or on_hold::boolean is false) and u.id = :currentUserId ) as "q3", (select count(1) from flow.project p inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.user_project up on up.project_id = p.id inner join flow.user_position upos on upos.id = up.user_position_id and upos.position_id = 1 inner join flow.user u on u.id = upos.user_id left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 112, p.id, 57, false) as first_cash_payment_paid_date) first_cash_payment_paid_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 104, p.id, 9, false) as final_design_signed_date) final_design_signed_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 108, p.id, 4, false) as agreement_signed_date) agreement_signed_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 109, p.id, 4, false) as financier) financier on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 52, p.id, 0, false) as cancelled_date) cancelled_date on true left join lateral (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 200, p.id, 0, false) as on_hold) on_hold on true where final_design_signed_date is not null and agreement_signed_date is not null and case when financier = 'Cash' then first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null and greatest(first_cash_payment_paid_date::date, final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q4_start from quarters) and (select q4_end from quarters) else greatest(final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date) between (select q4_start from quarters) and (select q4_end from quarters) end and ((cancelled_date is null) or (cancelled_date is not null and cancelled_date::date > (select q4_end from quarters))) and (on_hold is null or on_hold::boolean is false) and u.id = :currentUserId ) as "q4"
sql.closerDashboard.getCloserTableScores: SELECT u.id, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as name, cust.user_status_type, o.org_name as companyName, o2.org_name as region, '--' as salesMetroArea, -- TODO: Add sales_metro_area once it has been migrated count(case when appointment_date::date >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and source not in ('Referral', 'Setter Gen', 'Events - Closer Gen') and final_design_signed_date is not null and agreement_signed_date is not null and case when financier = 'Cash' then first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null else 1=1 end and (on_hold is null or on_hold::boolean is false) then 1 end) as leadGenFdcPercentageNumerator, count(case when appointment_date::date >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and source not in ('Referral', 'Setter Gen', 'Events - Closer Gen') then 1 end) as leadGenFdcPercentageDenominator, count(case when greatest(final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date, first_cash_payment_paid_date::date) >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and source not in ('Referral', 'Setter Gen', 'Events - Closer Gen') and final_design_signed_date is not null and agreement_signed_date is not null and case when financier = 'Cash' then first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null else 1=1 end and (on_hold is null or on_hold::boolean is false) then 1 end) as selfGenFdc, count(case when greatest(final_design_signed_date::date, agreement_signed_date::date, first_cash_payment_paid_date::date) >= (now() at time zone 'US/Mountain')::date - :timeInterval and final_design_signed_date is not null and agreement_signed_date is not null and case when financier = 'Cash' then first_cash_payment_paid_date is not null else 1=1 end and (on_hold is null or on_hold::boolean is false) then 1 end) as totalFdc FROM flow.project p INNER JOIN flow.contact c ON c.id = p.contact_id INNER JOIN flow.user_project up ON up.project_id = p.id INNER JOIN flow.user_position upos ON upos.id = up.user_position_id INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = upos.org_id INNER JOIN flow.org o2 ON (o2.id = o.parent_org_id and o2.org_type_id = 2) INNER JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = upos.user_id INNER JOIN flow.user_status_type ust ON ust.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN flow.company_user_status_type cust ON cust.id = ust.company_user_status_type_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 1, p.id, 1, false) as appointment_date) appointment_date ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 5, p.id, 0, false) as source) source ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 109, p.id, 4, false) as financier) financier ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(1, 200, p.id, 0, false) as on_hold) on_hold ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 112, p.id, 57, false) as first_cash_payment_paid_date) first_cash_payment_paid_date ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 104, p.id, 9, false) as final_design_signed_date) final_design_signed_date ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (select * from flow.get_value_for_custom_field(4, 108, p.id, 4, false) as agreement_signed_date) agreement_signed_date ON TRUE WHERE CASE WHEN :officeRanking IS TRUE THEN -- Office Ranking (1st row of tables) upos.org_id IN (select distinct org_id from flow.user_position where user_id = :currentUserId and archived is false and primary_flag is true) ELSE -- Company Ranking (2nd row of tables) upos.position_id = 1 AND upos.archived IS FALSE AND upos.end_date IS NULL AND o.active_flag IS TRUE AND o2.active_flag IS TRUE END AND cust.user_status_type = 'Active' GROUP BY u.id, companyName, region, cust.user_status_type
